lines.text: 你迷惑了我的身心，我爱你。我爱你。我爱你。
lines.en: You have bewitched me, body and soul, and I love, I love, I love you.
lines.note: 雨中达西的告白：傲慢褪尽之后，爱意只能连说三遍。

lines.text: 我挣扎过，但没有用。我的感情再也压抑不住了。请允许我告诉你——我是多么热烈地爱慕着你。
lines.en: In vain I have struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.
lines.note: 达西第一次求婚（节选）；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 无论你用哪种方式求婚，都不可能让我接受。
lines.en: You could not have made me the offer of your hand in any possible way that would have tempted me to accept it.
lines.note: 伊丽莎白的拒绝；IMDb quotes 可查。
